(* --- 2.3 Slurry Volumetric Flow 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bFlow_A_OK := (rSlurryFlow_A >= -50.0) AND (rSlurryFlow_A <= 3000.0);
bFlow_B_OK := (rSlurryFlow_B >= -50.0) AND (rSlurryFlow_B <= 3000.0);

ELSIF bFlow_A_OK AND bFlow_B_OK THEN

    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0100;
ELSIF bFlow_B_OK AND bFlow_C_OK THEN
    rVotedSlurryFlow := (rSlurryFlow_B + rSlurryFlow_C) * 0.5;
    bFlow_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0200;
ELSIF bFlow_A_OK AND bFlow_C_OK THEN

(* --- 2.4 Radiometric Slurry Mixture Density 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bDens_A_OK := (rSlurryDensity_A >= 950.0) AND (rSlurryDensity_A <= 1800.0);
bDens_B_OK := (rSlurryDensity_B >= 950.0) AND (rSlurryDensity_B <= 1800.0);

IF bDens_A_OK AND bDens_B_OK AND bDens_C_OK THEN

ELSIF bDens_B_OK AND bDens_C_OK THEN

ELSIF bDens_A_OK AND bDens_C_OK THEN

rSlurryMixtureDensity := rVotedSlurryDensity;

(* --- 2.5 Riser Base Ring Microstrain 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bStrn_A_OK := (rRiserMicroStrain_A >= 100.0) AND (rRiserMicroStrain_A <= 2500.0);
bStrn_B_OK := (rRiserMicroStrain_B >= 100.0) AND (rRiserMicroStrain_B <= 2500.0);
bStrn_C_OK := (rRiserMicroStrain_C >= 100.0) AND (rRiserMicroStrain_C <= 2500.0);

IF bStrn_A_OK AND bStrn_B_OK AND bStrn_C_OK THEN

    ELSIF (rRiserMicroStrain_B >= rRiserMicroStrain_A AND rRiserMicroStrain_B <= rRiserMicroStrain_C) OR
          (rRiserMicroStrain_B >= rRiserMicroStrain_C AND rRiserMicroStrain_B <= rRiserMicroStrain_A) THEN

    bStrn_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bStrn_B_OK AND bStrn_C_OK THEN

ELSIF bStrn_A_OK AND bStrn_C_OK THEN
    rVotedRiserMicroStrain := (rRiserMicroStrain_A + rRiserMicroStrain_C) * 0.5;
    bStrn_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;

    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0020; (* Riser Base Strain TMR Failure *)

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 VERTICAL MULTI-PHASE DRIFT-FLUX HYDRAULIC TRANSPORT MODEL                            *)
(* Solves Zuber-Findlay liquid-solid drift flux across 5,000m vertical riser column.         *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Compute Mixture Superficial Velocity j = Q / A [m/s] *)
rSuperficialVelocity_j := (rVotedSlurryFlow / 3600.0) / c_rRiserCrossSectionArea;
rActualSlurryVelocity := rSuperficialVelocity_j;

(* Compute In-situ Volumetric Solid Fraction alpha_s from Mixture Density *)
(* rho_mixture = alpha_s * rho_solid + (1 - alpha_s) * rho_water *)
IF rNoduleSolidDensity > 1030.0 THEN
    rEstimatedSolidFrac := (rVotedSlurryDensity - 1030.0) / (rNoduleSolidDensity - 1030.0);
ELSE
    rEstimatedSolidFrac := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rEstimatedSolidFrac < 0.0 THEN
    rEstimatedSolidFrac := 0.0;
ELSIF rEstimatedSolidFrac > 0.45 THEN
    rEstimatedSolidFrac := 0.45; (* Packing limit clamp *)
END_IF;

(* Estimate Dry Nodule Mass Throughput Rate [t/h] *)
rEstimatedDryMassFlow := (rSuperficialVelocity_j * c_rRiserCrossSectionArea * 3600.0) *
                         (rEstimatedSolidFrac * rNoduleSolidDensity) / 1000.0;

(* Terminal Settling Velocity of Spheroid Nodules (Rubey-Schiller-Naumann formulation) *)
(* v0 = sqrt( (4/3) * g * d_p * (rho_s - rho_f) / (rho_f * Cd) ) *)
rTmpDiff := rNoduleSolidDensity - 1030.0;
IF rTmpDiff > 0.0 AND rNoduleMeanDiameter > 0.0 THEN
    rTerminalSettlingVel_v0 := SQRT((4.0 / 3.0) * c_rGravity * (rNoduleMeanDiameter / 1000.0) *
                                   (rTmpDiff / (1030.0 * rDragCoefficient_Cd)));
ELSE
    rTerminalSettlingVel_v0 := 0.35;
END_IF;

(* Richardson-Zaki Hindered Settling Velocity in Slurry: vt = v0 * (1 - alpha_s)^4.45 *)
IF rEstimatedSolidFrac < 1.0 THEN
    rHinderedSettlingVel_vt := rTerminalSettlingVel_v0 * EXPT(1.0 - rEstimatedSolidFrac, 4.45);
ELSE
    rHinderedSettlingVel_vt := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Zuber-Findlay Relative Drift Flux Velocity: V_dj = - vt * (1 - C0 * alpha_s) *)
rDriftVelocity_Vdj := - rHinderedSettlingVel_vt * (1.0 - (rDistributionParam_C0 * rEstimatedSolidFrac));

(* Durand-Condolios Critical Deposition Velocity: Vc = FL * sqrt( 2 * g * D * (rho_s - rho_f)/rho_f ) *)
rCriticalVelocity := rDurandFactor_FL * SQRT(2.0 * c_rGravity * c_rRiserInnerDiam * (rTmpDiff / 1030.0));

(* Low Slurry Velocity Pipe Blockage Interlock Warning *)
IF (rSuperficialVelocity_j > 0.1) AND (rSuperficialVelocity_j < (rCriticalVelocity * 1.12)) THEN
    bCriticalVelocityAlert := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Slurry Deposition / Choking Risk *)
ELSE
    bCriticalVelocityAlert := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Slurry Effective Viscosity: Thomas-Krieger-Dougherty Formula *)
(* mu_m = mu_w * (1.0 + 2.5*alpha_s + 10.05*alpha_s^2 + 0.00273 * exp(16.6 * alpha_s)) *)
rSlurryApparentViscosity := rSeawaterViscosity * (1.0 + (2.5 * rEstimatedSolidFrac) +
                                                 (10.05 * rEstimatedSolidFrac * rEstimatedSolidFrac) +
                                                 (0.00273 * EXP(16.6 * rEstimatedSolidFrac)));

(* Bulk Slurry Reynolds Number: Re = rho_m * j * D / mu_m *)
IF rSlurryApparentViscosity > 0.0001 AND rSuperficialVelocity_j > 0.01 THEN
    rMixtureReynoldsNumber := (rVotedSlurryDensity * rSuperficialVelocity_j * c_rRiserInnerDiam) /
                              rSlurryApparentViscosity;
ELSE
    rMixtureReynoldsNumber := 1000.0;
END_IF;

(* Explicit Swamee-Jain Darcy-Weisbach Friction Factor *)
(* f = 0.25 / [ log10( epsilon/(3.7*D) + 5.74 / Re^0.9 ) ]^2 *)
IF rMixtureReynoldsNumber > 3000.0 THEN
    rTmpA := (c_rPipeRoughness / (3.7 * c_rRiserInnerDiam)) +
             (5.74 / EXPT(rMixtureReynoldsNumber, 0.9));
    rTmpB := LN(rTmpA) / 2.302585; (* log10(x) = ln(x)/ln(10) *)
    rDarcyFrictionFactor := 0.25 / (rTmpB * rTmpB);
ELSE
    rDarcyFrictionFactor := 64.0 / rMixtureReynoldsNumber; (* Laminar regime *)
END_IF;

(* 5,000-Meter Friction Head Loss in Bar: Delta_P_fric = f * (L/D) * (rho_m * j^2 / 2) / 100000.0 *)
rFrictionalHeadLoss := (rDarcyFrictionFactor * (c_rRiserLength / c_rRiserInnerDiam) *
                       (rVotedSlurryDensity * rSuperficialVelocity_j * rSuperficialVelocity_j * 0.5)) / 100000.0;

(* Hydrostatic Differential Between External Seawater and Internal Slurry Column *)
(* Delta_P_hydro = (rho_m - rho_ocean) * g * L / 100000.0 *)
rHydrostaticHeadDiff := ((rVotedSlurryDensity - 1030.0) * c_rGravity * c_rRiserLength) / 100000.0;

(* Total Dynamic Hydraulic Lift Head Loss Across 5,000m *)
rTotalLiftHeadLoss := rFrictionalHeadLoss + rHydrostaticHeadDiff;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 MULTI-STAGE CENTRIFUGAL SLURRY PUMP CAVITATION INTERLOCK & ACOUSTIC MONITORING        *)
(* Evaluates real-time Net Positive Suction Head Available (NPSHA) vs Required (NPSHR).     *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Antoine Formulation for Seawater Vapor Pressure at Abyssal Temperature (1.8 deg C) *)
(* In bar: Pv ~ 0.0069 bar; include dissolved nitrogen/oxygen degassing margin 0.85 bar *)
rVaporPressure_Pv := 0.00692 + (0.00045 * rSeawaterAmbientTemp);

(* Calculate NPSHA in meters: NPSHA = (P_suction - Pv - P_degas)*1e5 / (rho_m * g) + v_in^2/(2*g) *)
IF rVotedSlurryDensity > 500.0 THEN
    rCalculatedNPSHA := ((rVotedSuctionPress - rVaporPressure_Pv - rDegassingPressureMargin) * 100000.0) /
                        (rVotedSlurryDensity * c_rGravity) +
                        ((rSuperficialVelocity_j * rSuperficialVelocity_j) / (2.0 * c_rGravity));
ELSE
    rCalculatedNPSHA := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Calculate NPSHR with Slurry and Speed Derating: *)
(* NPSHR = NPSHR_water * (N / N_rated)^2 * (1 + 1.25 * alpha_s + 0.15 * d_nodule/D_pipe) *)
IF c_rRatedSpeed > 100.0 THEN
    rTmpA := rPumpSpeedFeedback / c_rRatedSpeed;
    rSlurryCavitationDerate := 1.0 + (1.25 * rEstimatedSolidFrac) +
                              (0.15 * (rNoduleMeanDiameter / 1000.0) / c_rRiserInnerDiam);
    rCalculatedNPSHR := c_rRatedNPSHR_Water * (rTmpA * rTmpA) * rSlurryCavitationDerate;
ELSE
    rCalculatedNPSHR := c_rRatedNPSHR_Water;
END_IF;

(* Dimensionless Cavitation Margin Ratio CMR = NPSHA / NPSHR *)
IF rCalculatedNPSHR > 0.1 THEN
    rCavitationMarginRatio := rCalculatedNPSHA / rCalculatedNPSHR;
ELSE
    rCavitationMarginRatio := 10.0;
END_IF;

(* High-Frequency Ultrasonic Cavitation Envelope Filter *)
(* First-order lag filter on acoustic emission RMS *)
rCavitationAcousticFilt := (0.92 * rCavitationAcousticFilt) + (0.08 * rAcousticCavitationRMS);
rCavitationEnergyDeriv := (rCavitationAcousticFilt - rPrevAcousticEnergy) / c_rScanTimeSeconds;
rPrevAcousticEnergy := rCavitationAcousticFilt;

(* Normalized Acoustic Cavitation Severity Index (Baseline ~0.015 mV) *)
rAcousticCavitationIdx := rCavitationAcousticFilt / 0.015;

(* Cumulative Cavitation Stress Integrator *)
IF rAcousticCavitationIdx > 2.2 THEN
    rCavitationIntegrator := rCavitationIntegrator + (rAcousticCavitationIdx - 2.2) * c_rScanTimeSeconds;
ELSE
    rCavitationIntegrator := rCavitationIntegrator * 0.995; (* Slow decay recovery *)
END_IF;

(* Cavitation Warning and Interlock Governor *)
IF (rCavitationMarginRatio < 1.15) OR (rAcousticCavitationIdx > 2.5) THEN
    bCavitationWarning := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0080; (* Incipient Cavitation Advisory *)
    rSpeedDerateFactor := 0.88; (* Derate speed by 12% to restore suction head *)
ELSE
    bCavitationWarning := FALSE;
    rSpeedDerateFactor := 1.00;
END_IF;

(* Persistent Cavitation Trip Interlock Debounce *)
tonCavitationPersist(IN := (rCavitationMarginRatio < 1.03) OR (rAcousticCavitationIdx > 4.5) OR (rCavitationIntegrator > 15.0),
                     PT := T#1500MS);

IF tonCavitationPersist.Q THEN
    bCavitationInterlock := TRUE;
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0100; (* Severe Cavitation Trip Interlock *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 ACOUSTIC STRUCTURAL RESONANCE & RISER DYNAMIC STRAIN COMPENSATION                   *)
(* Implements digital biquad notch filter and active counter-torque damping injection.       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Separate static tension from oscillating dynamic bending strain *)
rStrainDC_Baseline := (0.999 * rStrainDC_Baseline) + (0.001 * rVotedRiserMicroStrain);
rStrainAC_Dynamic  := rVotedRiserMicroStrain - rStrainDC_Baseline;
rRiserDynamicMicroStrain := ABS(rStrainAC_Dynamic);

(* Derivative of dynamic strain d(epsilon)/dt *)
rStrainDerivative := (rStrainAC_Dynamic - rPrevStrainAC) / c_rScanTimeSeconds;
rPrevStrainAC := rStrainAC_Dynamic;

(* Track dominant transverse vortex shedding frequency *)
IF rRiserVibrationFreq > 0.05 AND rRiserVibrationFreq < 1.50 THEN
